text: Ekopak NV's transparency notifications disclose: Marc Coucke controls Alychlo NV and Mylecke Management, Art & Invest NV — together 57.64% of Ekopak's voting rights (16 May 2025) — and Pieter Loose controls Pilovan BV, holding 25.29% (20 November 2025).
short: Marc Coucke's group holds 57.64% of Ekopak; founder Pieter Loose's Pilovan holds 25.29%.

source.name: Ekopak: Share at a Glance (shareholder structure and transparency notifications)
source.quote: The overview above is based on the disclosures and notifications received by the company.
source.note: Notifications linked on the page: 22 May 2025 PDF — Alychlo NV 9,899,210 voting rights (56.56%), Marc Coucke personally 190,326 (1.09%), Mylecke Management, Art & Invest NV 178,572 shares (group total 57.64%); 'Marc Coucke controls Alychlo NV and Mylecke Management, Art & Invest NV'. 21 Nov 2025 PDF — Pilovan BV 4,426,700 (25.29%); 'Pieter LOOSE controls PILOVAN BV'.
